title: horizon/<site_id>.json: terrain horizon mask seen from the site
description: For each azimuth, the elevation angle of the highest terrain along that line of sight, including lunar curvature. Azimuth and elevation are in the site's topocentric frame (see contracts/README.md, Conventions).

observer_height_m.description: eye height above local terrain used for the mask

max_range_km.description: how far out terrain was considered

azimuth_deg.description: strictly increasing, uniform step recommended (e.g. 0.5 or 1 deg)

horizon_elev_uncertainty_deg.description: optional single +/- value for the whole mask
